description: This file defines an interface IUserRepository in the taskflow_api_backend.Repositories namespace, representing an abstraction for user-related data access operations, including CRUD actions and queries by email, username, and ID.

classes.name: IUserRepository
classes.description: Repository abstraction for User entity, providing asynchronous methods for user data retrieval and modification.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user by its unique identifier asynchronously.

methods.name: GetByUsernameAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user by username asynchronously.

methods.name: GetByEmailAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user by email asynchronously.

methods.name: ExistsByEmailAsync
methods.description: Checks if a user exists with the specified email asynchronously.
